rows.whatChanged:
Two changes, one at the shared host and one in this family's own builder, and nothing else in this family's directory beyond the rebuilt bytes and the digests its rendered-artifacts.json records.
(1) THE SPLITTER, AT THE HOST. scripts/rcap-custom-pleading/composed-family-host.mjs carried the character-accumulating splitToken inside renderComposedPdf: it appended one character at a time and cut wherever the column ran out, which is how …first-offender-nontraffic-misdemeanor-conviction-expungemen ⁄ t-99-19-71-1 reached five delivered pages per fixture and severed the word 'expungement'. It is replaced by createTokenSplitter({ fits: fitsByFontMetrics(font, fontSize, maxWidth) }) from the shared scripts/rcap-custom-pleading/split-token.mjs — the module FIX16 wrote, FIX21 moved the Georgia and Kentucky hosts onto and FIX35 moved the Rhode Island host onto. The key now breaks at its own separator: …first-offender-nontraffic-misdemeanor-conviction- ⁄ expungement-99-19-71-1. The host asserts splitToken.hardSplits === 0 for each composed document it renders, so a future key with no separator to break on fails the build instead of shipping chopped.
(2) THE TRAILER IS OUT OF THE COURT'S BLOCK, IN THIS FAMILY'S BUILDER. composedBody in scripts/build-census-v1-ms-misd-1st-set.mjs appended the 'Route:' trailer to every component, which on the proposed order made it the last ink of the document — printed below 'JUDICIAL OFFICER OF THE COURT …', below '(the Court alone completes, signs and enters this order)' and below 'APPROVED AS TO FORM, for the prosecuting authority:' with its own empty rule, on a delivered page 4 whose every other line belongs to the judge or the prosecutor. The same line is now pushed once, immediately above 'SO ORDERED.', so it closes the preparer's half of the order above the whole execution and approval band; the trailing push is suppressed for that one component and is unchanged for every other component. This is FIX35's move on the Rhode Island host, made where this architecture keeps the order body: the host renders each component to its own PDF from the text its family builder composes, so the host has no page on which to place a line it does not author, and a host-level rule keyed on the proposed_order role would have moved the bytes of four other families on this host that this lane holds no grant for.
NO NEW PAGINATION SCHEME. The host still draws row by row and breaks a page at y < margin, exactly as before; no pull-down, no block pagination, no suppression was added. Placement only: not one character of the decretal block, the findings, the entry date, the judge line, the approval line, the court-selected term, the route key itself, the source pin, the component set, the field maps or any instruction line was changed, added or removed. The full pdftotext diff of both fixtures shows exactly two kinds of change and nothing else: the five per-fixture key breaks moving to the separator, and the order's trailer moving from after the approval note to before 'SO ORDERED.'.
